gloss: on the other hand; while; reverse side

definitions.gloss: on the other hand; while; at the same time
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce a contrasting aspect or perspective. Indicates that something has both a positive and negative side.
The opposite or back side of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧な{反面|はんめん}、⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: While convenient, there are also dangers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧{反面|はんめん}、⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧な⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: While he is kind, he also has a stubborn side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反面教師|はんめんきょうし}→反面教師：24589_hanmenkyoushi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To learn from someone as a negative example.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反面|はんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To see the other side of things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反面|はんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: On the flip side of success, there are also risks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反面|はんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れては→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧いけない。
examples.english: We must not forget that responsibility comes with the other side of freedom.

notes:
{反面|はんめん} presents contrasting aspects of the same thing — acknowledging that something has both a positive and a negative side.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [i-adj/verb]{反面|はんめん}、〜: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧な{反面|はんめん}、⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧もある (while convenient, there are dangers)
- [na-adj]な{反面|はんめん}、〜: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{反面|はんめん}、⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧だ (while quiet, it's inconvenient)
- [noun]の{反面|はんめん}: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧の{反面|はんめん} (the flip side of success)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{反面教師|はんめんきょうし}→反面教師：24589_hanmenkyoushi⟧: a negative example — someone whose mistakes you learn from. A very well-known compound.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧で: 'on the other hand' (more neutral, can introduce unrelated contrast)
- その{反面|はんめん}: 'conversely' (used to introduce the contrasting point)
- {半面|はんめん}: 'half the face' — a different word with different kanji

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in writing and structured speech.
